parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the multi-zone instance.

parameters.name: CoreDiskSize
parameters.description: The disk size of core nodes. The value must be greater than the current disk size and must be a multiple of 40. Unit: GB. Maximum value: 64000.

parameters.name: LogDiskSize
parameters.description: The disk size of log nodes. The value must be greater than the current disk size of log nodes and must be a multiple of 40. Unit: GB. Maximum value: 8000.
